market.worldSizeUSD_B_range: Estimates vary: global home textiles $230.99B (2025) to $338.37B by 2032 (5.60%/yr) per one source, or $137.81B (2025) to $231.40B by 2033 (6.9%/yr) per another with a materially different base.
globalCompetitors: not applicable globally in a branded sense — see peers[] for listed Indian comparables that compete for the same US/EU private-label supply relationships
market.domesticSlice: India home textile market: $4.51B (2025) to $6.78B by 2034 (4.65%/yr) per one estimate, or 8.4%/yr (2024-2033) reaching $24,228.3M by 2033 per another — wide dispersion across research houses. Bed linen is the largest product segment (~41.05% share, 2025); towels are the fastest-growing application segment.

structureFacts: Asia-Pacific held 43.74% global home-textiles share (2024); India is APAC's fastest-growing home-textiles market
US tariff timing and trade-policy shifts have directly affected shipment scheduling and margins for India's largest home-textile exporters in FY26

adoptionStructure.note: Retail seasonal buying cycles (back-to-school, holiday) and multi-year private-label supply contracts with major US/EU home-goods retailers — not a fixed repurchase rate
